authorization.reference: Owner message: PREPATLAS — PUBLISH THE COMPLETE AP CHEMISTRY QUESTION BANK
authorization.scope: All 1001 existing Chemistry MCQs across 91 topics; internal Practice publication only; no public deployment.

reviewMethod: Re-ran frozen source inventory, strict schema/ID/count checks and existing arithmetic/scientific-model suite.
Separately re-solved flagged PES, periodic-trend, polarity and pre-equilibrium cases; checked all alternatives and assumptions.
Compared TF-IDF prompt similarity within each topic; reviewed all12 pairs with cosine greater than0.62. Similarity is a triage tool, not a proof of semantic originality.
Retained all1001 question objects unchanged after review. No independently human-reviewed status is asserted.

decisions.reason: The supplied photon energy balance yields binding energy42eV with exactly one numerical option. The task interprets a PES measurement, directly supporting1.6.A; overlap with later photon arithmetic is intentional reinforcement, not a duplicate or missing prerequisite formula.

006 explains a qualitative down-group ranking;010 estimates a missing value from supplied numerical data. Both use the same periodic principle but assess explanation versus data-based estimation. No need to invent an exceptional Aufbau configuration.

Separate targets are relative bond polarity, partial-charge direction, distinguishing bonding classes, and the effectively nonpolar C–H convention. Supplied electronegativities support one answer; no universal cutoff or exact dipole magnitude is inferred.

Upper-difficulty algebraic application, not advanced-mechanism recall. The positive-root and inverse-concentration relations are supplied. Slow-step substitution yields unique forms under explicitly restricted pre-equilibrium conditions. No fractional molecularity, zero-concentration extrapolation, steady-state differential equations or Arrhenius calculation is required.
Free concentrations and remaining-pool balances are explicitly distinguished. Recalculated rates0.00120 and0.0100M/s and third-order effective units M^-2 s^-1; no alternative matches.

limitations: Automated/same-assistant scientific review is not independent human scientific review and does not guarantee absence of every error.
Lexical similarity does not detect all conceptual repetition; retained overlaps represent different operations or complementary cases.
Some conceptual correct choices are longer than distractors; future editorial calibration can reduce cues without a known scientific withholding reason.
The original unavailable historical full sources remain unavailable. Published replacements retain the recorded provenance.
